description: You have draconic lineage, granting draconic powers.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: AC = 13 + DEX unarmored. Gain resistance to damage type of dragon ancestor.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Add CHA modifier to spell damage rolls matching dragon type.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: Bonus action to manifest wings. Gain flying speed equal to movement speed.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: Enemies within 60 feet have disadvantage on saving throws vs your spells.
